newsSince: Shuanglin's humanoid component case improved but remains pre-designation: 2025 revenue was RMB 5.484B, it has built a 1,500-set trial line for inverted planetary roller screws, and a 100,000-unit mass-production line was scheduled for June 2026. The caveat is that products had not yet received formal designated supply contracts in the cited filings/articles.

verdicts.rankRationale: The 100k-unit roller-screw line is a real capacity signal for humanoid linear joints, and the sample pipeline validates the automotive-to-robotics transition. Keep the upgrade measured because formal designated supply contracts are still missing.
verdicts.bull: Roller-screw/actuation candidate for humanoid body-stack with large rerating room after a big YTD pullback (-24%).
verdicts.neutral: Component thesis unconfirmed - still in verification, no designation; auto-parts core dominates.
verdicts.bear: No humanoid design win secured; remains an auto-parts supplier with speculative robot optionality.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: Roller-screw customer designation / humanoid design win.
verdicts.primaryRisk: Verification fails or designation slips; thesis stays speculative.
